modules.name: Simple LFO4-ss
modules.description: Simple knob-controlled Quad-LFO, with internal sync (Saw and Sine).

modules.name: Simple LFO4-st
modules.description: Simple knob-controlled Quad-LFO, with internal sync (Square and Triangle).

modules.name: Tiny LFO
modules.description: Tiny (2HP) knob/CV-controlled single LFO with PWM (Saw, Square, Triangle, and Sine).

modules.name: LFO1
modules.description: Knob/CV-controlled single LFO with PWM, MOD, external sync and n-shot mode (Saw, Square, Triangle and Sine). Using the Square-output with modulation, it also acts as a wavetable (Triangle<->Square<->Saw).

modules.name: Phase-Driven LFO
modules.description: Phase-driven LFO (input-phase) with PWM/modulation, outputting Saw, Square, Triangle and Sine, and inverted.

modules.name: Tweak-2 Mk I
modules.description: 2 section: (same) knob/CV-controlled (1x,2x,5x,10x) attenuverter/amplifier, offset.

modules.name: Tweak-2 Mk II
modules.description: 2 section: (individual) knob controlled (1x,2x,5x,10x) attenuverter/amplifier, offset, mixer.

modules.name: Tweak-4 Mk I
modules.description: 4 section: (same) knob controlled (1x,2x,5x,10x) attenuverter/amplifier, offset.

modules.name: Tweak-4 Mk II
modules.description: 4 section: (individual) knob/CV-controlled (1x,2x,5x,10x) attenuverter/amplifier, offset, mixer.

modules.name: Tweak-8
modules.description: 8 section: (individual) knob/CV-controlled (1x,2x,5x,10x) attenuverter/amplifier, offset, mixer.

modules.name: VCA-2
modules.description: 2 section VCA each with knob/CV for each.

modules.name: VCA-4 Mk I
modules.description: 4 section VCA with shared knob/CV (same for all 4 sections).

modules.name: VCA-4 Mk II
modules.description: 4 section VCA with knob/CV for each.

modules.name: Clamp 4
modules.description: Clamp/clip (invert) up to 4 inputs, in selected range.

modules.name: Auto-Scale 4
modules.description: Automatic scale/offset (invert) to selected range of up to 4 inputs.

modules.name: Manuel Trigger, Gate and CV
modules.description: Controller to manually output 1 trigger-, 2-gate and 2 CV-signals.

modules.name: Manuel Push 2
modules.description: Controller with 2 buttons, that each fires a gate and high/low-triggers. Can also convert gates to triggers (or vice versa).

modules.name: Manuel Trigger 8
modules.description: Controller to manually output 8 trigger-signals (mono/polyphonic).

modules.name: Manuel Gate 8
modules.description: Controller to manually output 8 gate-signals (mono/polyphonic).

modules.name: Manuel CV 8 Mk I
modules.description: Controller to manually set 8 fixed CV outputs (mono/polyphonic).

modules.name: Manuel CV 8 Mk II
modules.description: Controller to manually set 8 fixed ON/OFF CV outputs, and switch between them (mono/polyphonic).

modules.name: Manuel Mix 4 Mk I
modules.description: Manually knob-operated mixer with 4 inputs and 1 output (averaging or unity mix).

modules.name: Manuel Mix 4 Mk II
modules.description: Manually knob/CV-operated mixer with 4 inputs, individual outputs and 1 mix output (averaging or unity mix).

modules.name: Manuel Mix 4 Stereo
modules.description: Manually knob/CV-operated mixer with 4 stereo-inputs and stereo mix output (averaging or unity mix).

modules.name: Mute 2
modules.description: 2 knob/cv-controlled mute-sections each with a single input/output-pair.

modules.name: Manuel Mute 8
modules.description: Controller to manually mute 8 signals.

modules.name: CV-Toggle 8
modules.description: Switch with 8 sections, each with 2 stages (via CV).

modules.name: CV to Gate
modules.description: Fire gate/trigger if CV is within specified range (1 section).

modules.name: CV to Gate/Trigger 8
modules.description: Fire gate/trigger if CV is within specified range (8 sections).

modules.name: Mult2x4
modules.description: Mult with 2 section each with 4 outputs (also works as 1-to-8 mult).

modules.name: Merge/Mult-4
modules.description: Merge/Mult with 4 inputs/outputs (merge can either sum or mix, and can have special handling of negative values).

modules.name: Merge2x4
modules.description: Merge with 2 section each with 4 inputs (merge can either sum or mix, and can have special handling of negative values).

modules.name: Tiny Logic Comparator-2
modules.description: 2 sections with 4 inputs for logical compare: AND, OR, XOR (and negated via context-menu).

modules.name: Logic Comparator-2
modules.description: 2 sections of logic compare, with true/false input, and two sections of: AND, NAND, OR, NOR, XOR, XNOR.

modules.name: Logic Comparator-6x2
modules.description: 6 sections each with 2 input for Logic compare (AND, NAND, OR, NOR, XOR, XNOR).

modules.name: Value Comparator-1
modules.description: One section of value-compare: A=B, A!=B, A>=B, A>B, A<=B, A<B, with threshold knob, A/B-cross trigger and tolerance-clamp.

modules.name: Value Comparator-2 Mk I
modules.description: Value compare with true/false input, threshold and two sections of: A=B, A!=B, A>=B, A>B, A<=B, A<B.

modules.name: Value Comparator-2 Mk II
modules.description: One section of value-compare: Min, Max, NtZ, FtZ, Abs-diff, Avg, and one section of Int/Frac and simple math: Plus, Minus, Mul, Div.

modules.name: S&H/T&H-2
modules.description: Sample/track-and-hold with 2 sections (1 input/output), each triggered by input or internal LFO.

modules.name: S&H/T&H-2x4
modules.description: Sample/track-and-hold with 2 sections (4 input/output), each triggered by input or internal LFO.

modules.name: Sample and Update
modules.description: Sample-and-Update with button/CV for Sample, Reset and Update. Can also count number of triggers detected, and output a trigger when the desired count have been reached.

modules.name: Poly-Merge
modules.description: Merge (up to) 16 monophonic signals (or multiple polyphonic signals) into a polyphonic signal.

modules.name: Poly-Split
modules.description: Split a polyphonic signal into (up to) 16 monophonic signals (or multiple polyphonic signals).

modules.name: Poly-Stereo
modules.description: Encode/Decode 2 monophonic left/right signals to/from 2 channel polyphonic signals.

modules.name: Poly-Quad
modules.description: Encode/Decode 4 monophonic signals to/from 4 channel polyphonic signals (basically an up to 4 channel merger/splitter).

modules.name: Poly-Shuffle
modules.description: Add/Remove/Shuffle channels of a polyphonic signal. Can also be used to construct a polyphonic signal with up to 16 gates.

modules.name: Poly-Tweak Mk I
modules.description: Invert/Disable (mute/remove) channels of a polyphonic signal based on buttons. Can also be used to construct a polyphonic signal with up to 16 gates.

modules.name: Poly-Tweak Mk II
modules.description: Invert/Disable (mute/remove) channels of a polyphonic signal based on CV-inputs. Can also be used to mix individual channels of two polyphonic signals.

modules.name: Poly-Logical Compare
modules.description: Perform logical-compare (AND,OR,XOR,NAND,NOR,XNOR) on all channels of same polyphonic-signal.

modules.name: Poly-Value Compare
modules.description: Perform value-compare (MIN,MAX,NtZ,FfZ,AVG,R/S) on all channels of same polyphonic-signal. Can also monitor (MIN,MAX,NtZ,FfZ,AVG,R/S) over time (since last reset), accross all channels or individually for each channel.

modules.name: Poly-Offset
modules.description: Offset individuel- or group of channels of a polyphonic-signal.

modules.name: Poly-Scale
modules.description: Scale (attenuvert/amplify) individuel- or group of channels of a polyphonic-signal.

modules.name: Cross-fade switch 1to4
modules.description: Cross-fade/switch 1 input into up to 4 outputs.

modules.name: Cross-fade switch 4to1
modules.description: Cross-fade/switch up to 4 inputs into 1 output.

modules.name: Cross-fade 1x2
modules.description: Cross-fade a stereo-signal, or two separate mono signals by knob/CV.

modules.name: Cross-fade 4x1
modules.description: Cross-fade 4 separate (mono) signals, by separate- and master cross-fade knob/CV.

modules.name: Bernoulli Switch
modules.description: Bernoulli switch with both 'A/B->' (2 input, 1 output) and '->A/B' (1 input, 2 output) sections.

modules.name: ON/OFF Switch
modules.description: Toggles between outputting the ON- or the OFF-signal, using button-, gate- or trigger to switch.

modules.name: Combine
modules.description: Combines (switches between) 2 inputs based on 3 different algorithms.

modules.name: Sign
modules.description: Outputs 9 different 'signed-versions' of the input signal(s).

modules.name: Sign4 Mk I
modules.description: 4 sections that either invert gate-, bipolar- or unipolar-signals.

modules.name: Sign4 Mk II
modules.description: 4 sections that either output absolute value, cut-negative or cut-positive values.

modules.name: Fold
modules.description: Applying gain and bias to input, in order to affect fold or wrap.

modules.name: Wave Shaper 2
modules.description: Have 3 different wave-shaping algorithms which can be modify 2 separate signals.

modules.name: Ring Modulator 3
modules.description: 3 Sections to perform ring-modulation of 3 signals.

modules.name: Increment/Decrement Offset
modules.description: Button/CV to increment/decrement offset applied to input signal.

modules.name: Delta-4
modules.description: Four sections measuring difference between current input and a captured reference level.

modules.name: Flip-Flop
modules.description: Flip-flop module able to both do D-, T- or SR- flip-flops.

modules.name: Slope Detector 2
modules.description: 2 sections with threshold slope detection (rise/steady/fall) with latched phases and configurable Steady hold time.

modules.name: Patch
modules.description: Mutable patch with 8 pairs of input/output for routing signals (typically you would use two modules at the same time to patch signals between them).

modules.name: Random-4
modules.description: Generates 4 (mono-/polyphonic) random values with min/max and distribution at each trigger or internal frequency.

modules.name: Random Curve
modules.description: Generates 6 shaped random cruves with min/max and distribution.

modules.name: Arm 3 XY
modules.description: Length and rotation of 3 'arms' (basically 3 polar vectors) generates a 'semi-random' curve X/Y-output.

modules.name: Turing Machine
modules.description: Turing machine for generating random sequences with 3-32 steps (16 gate/trigger- and 2-value outputs).

modules.name: Bits-to-Value
modules.description: Converts 8 bits (gate-inputs) into a CV-value based on dialed in weights and specified range.

modules.name: Value-to-Bits
modules.description: Converts a CV-input (clamped in specified range) into 8 monophonic- and 1 polyphonic gate-output (up to 16 channels).

modules.name: ADR Envelope
modules.description: Attack-Delay-Release Envelope with attack/release time and shape (technically it is an Attack-Sustain-Delay-Release Envelope).
